response.original_title: (FAQs@!!Room) How to book rooms for 5 people on Norwegian Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280 Norwegian Cruise has a very small number of specialty staterooms and high-end suites that can sleep 5 guests, but online booking tools usually cap standard room occupancy at 4. Yes, +1-866-829-1280 Norwegian Cruise has specific suites and family cabins that accommodate 5 people, though they cannot usually be booked online. Available on select ships (such as Solstice-class ships), +1-866-829-1280 these larger balcony cabins feature multiple sleeping areas or separate bedrooms that can accommodate up to 5 people. Because online tools restrict searches for 5 passengers in a single room, you must call Norwegian Cruise directly +1-866-829-1280 or use a travel agent to book a 5-person stateroom.
